adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 47-48 in addGuests.handler.ts: `const isTeamAdminOrOwner = (await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) && (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0));` - This uses `&&` (AND) operator, meaning a user must be BOTH team admin AND team owner to pass this check. The variable name `isTeamAdminOrOwner` suggests the intent was to accept users with EITHER role, which would require `||` (OR) operator. This is a logic bug that would incorrectly reject team admins who aren't owners and team owners who aren't admins.
